title.en: R 3 2022 RELIGIOUS COUNCIL AND KADIS COURTS CONVERTS RULES

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

text.en: These Rules may be cited as the Religious Council and Kadis Courts (Converts)

heading.en: Form to be completed by prospective converts to Muslim Religion

text.en: Every person wishing to become a convert to the Muslim religion shall submit a written statement, in duplicate, through the Kadis of the district in which he resides, in the form in the Schedule and shall sign such statement in the presence of a witness.

heading.en: Kadis to report conversions to Secretary to Majlis

text.en: After a Kadi has converted any person to the Islamic Religion he shall forward to the Secretary to the Majlis report of such conversion together with a copy of the written statement referred to in rule 2. Secretary to Majlis to issue certificate of conversion on report

The Majlis shall issue to every person on registration of his conversion to the Islamic Religion a certificate in Form B in the Schedule that he has been registered as a convert to that Religion. 6 Religious Council and Kadis Courts (rule 2) Form to be completed by intending converts to Islamic Religion.
